_comment: A1-dots pilot pool (ACL-063). VERBATIM copy of pool_2x_v6_bench48.json except: dataset name suffixed _a1dots_pilot; num_scenes=24; seed=20260714 (disjoint from training-pool seed 960960 and bench48 seed 20260708); output_dir=data/synthetic/pool_2x_dots_pilot; and the defects block retuned for real-chip small dark dots — hole_radius_px=[1,4] HR px (10um/px at 2x SR, 20um detector pitch => 20-80um dot diameters), max_holes=50 plus NEW min_holes=20 (hard per-scene count floor => count ~ U{20..50}), NEW hole_depth_range=[0.3,1.0] (per-hole partial depth: locally-darker dots instead of legacy full-depth zeroing), NEW hole_edge_softness_px=1.0 (soft/anti-aliased dot edges instead of hard boolean), severity_range pinned [1.0,1.0] (pilot decouples count randomness from severity; severity still only scales count ceilings), max_notches=0 and max_cracks=0 (dots only; notch_radius_px/crack_* keys retained but inert at zero counts). All other keys byte-identical to bench48 (n_frames_per_scene=96 kept). Motivation: real dark dots are locally-darker, soft-edged, small and dense; the legacy generator could only render full-depth, hard-boolean, sparse-large holes — see research_log/ood_generator_support_audit_draft.md.

physics_ranges._comment_delta_T: v6 CPU redesign: ΔT is a CONTINUOUS per-scene nuisance, NOT stepped by difficulty. delta_T_c_continuous = union min-max of the four legacy delta_T_c_by_difficulty ranges [0.3, 5.0]; when present, generate_training_pool samples ΔT from it and IGNORES difficulty. delta_T_c_by_difficulty retained only for schema/legacy compatibility.

_comment_difficulty: v6 CPU redesign: difficulty tiers are VESTIGIAL for this pool — CPU geometry uses a continuous `density` scalar (stored in geometry_metadata.density) and ΔT uses delta_T_c_continuous, neither gated by difficulty. Collapsed to a single bucket so the (still-threaded) difficulty label is uniform metadata.

detector_defects._note: disabled: real frames (min 18.67C) show no dead-pixel spikes; was injecting unrealistic <0C cold pixels
